# Ranjit Rajan — Webflow & Frontend Developer

> Portfolio of Ranjit Rajan, a Webflow and frontend developer in Kochi, Kerala, India, and co-founder of Cocaimo, a web development and digital marketing agency. He works directly with clients on design, development and SEO.

Ranjit has 4 years of experience building websites in Webflow and frontend code for agencies and product companies. This site is a single page listing his services, selected projects and contact details.

## Services

- Webflow & Custom Websites: Figma-to-Webflow builds, CMS collections, custom code where needed
- Speed & Performance: lean, fast-loading pages and image/asset optimisation
- SEO-Ready Builds: semantic HTML, structured headings, meta tags and schema markup
- UI/UX Design: layouts and interfaces designed for clarity and conversion

## Toolkit

Webflow, React, TypeScript, Sanity CMS, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Figma

## Selected Projects

- [JIITAK](https://www.jiitak.co.jp/): Website for a Japan-based product development and DX company. Built in Webflow from a Figma design, with CMS-driven case studies and blog, content filters and animations.
- [ARBUZA](https://www.arbuza.in/): Website for a precision-nutrition practice. Built in Webflow from the client's Figma design.
- [Cocaimo](https://www.cocaimo.com/): Agency website built in React and TypeScript, with SEO structure and schema markup.
